tb-201-1.question:
A boy walks from X to Z via Y (Fig a). The dotted line shows his path. Which of the following statements is/are correct?

Fig a

(1) The distance travelled from X to Y is equal to the distance travelled from X to Z.

(2) The distance travelled from X to Z is equal to the magnitude of the displacement from X to Z.

(3) The magnitude of the displacement from X to Y is equal to the magnitude of the displacement from X to Z.

A (3) only

B (1) and (2) only

C (1) and (3) only

D (2) and (3) only
tb-201-1.reasoning:
Distance is the total path length. Reaching Z requires both X→Y and Y→Z, so it is longer than the journey to Y alone. The curved path also exceeds the straight-line distance XZ. Thus (1) and (2) are false.

Displacement magnitude is the straight-line separation of the endpoints. XY and XZ are both three grid squares, so only (3) is correct: A.

tb-201-2.question:
A girl walks with an average speed of 3 km h–1 for an hour. Which of the following statements is incorrect?

A The magnitude of her total displacement cannot be greater than 3 km.

B Her instantaneous speed can be greater than 3 km h–1.

C The magnitude of her instantaneous velocity can be greater than 3 km h–1.

D The magnitude of her average velocity over the whole trip can be greater than 3 km h–1.
tb-201-2.reasoning:
Total distance=average speed×time=3×1=3 km. Displacement magnitude cannot exceed distance, so the magnitude of average velocity over the trip cannot exceed 3 km h⁻¹. D is incorrect.

An average is not an upper limit on instantaneous values. She can walk faster during one interval and slower during another, so instantaneous speed and velocity magnitude can exceed 3 km h⁻¹.

tb-201-3.question:
The Monkey King is trapped between the two hands of the Buddha (Fig b). He can only keep flying at a constant speed of 30 m s−1 from one of the Buddha’s hands to the other along a straight line. He changes his moving direction once he meets the hands. The hands are moving at 10 m s−1 towards the Monkey King to catch him. At t = 0, the hands are 80 m apart. What is the total distance travelled by the Monkey King from t = 0 to the moment the Buddha’s hands meet?

A 30 m

B 60 m

C 120 m

D 240 m
tb-201-3.reasoning:
Each hand moves 40 m before the two hands meet.

Time taken for the hands to meet

=dt=4010= 4 s

Total distance travelled by the Monkey King

= vt = 30 × 4 = 120 m

a ruler for measuring distance 1A

tb-201-11.question:
A man walks at velocity v towards the east for time t. Then he walks at velocity 2v towards the north for time 2t (Fig g). His average speed over the whole journey is 2 m s–1.

(a) Find the direction of his average velocity over the whole journey. (2 marks)

(b) Find the magnitude of his average velocity over the whole journey. (3 marks)
tb-201-11.answer:
(a) Let θ be the angle between the north and the displacement.

tan θ =vt2v×2t=14 1M

θ = 14.0°

The direction of his average velocity is N14.0°E. 1A

(b) Average speed =totaldistancetravelledtotaltimeoftravel

2 =vt+2v×2tt+2t 1M

2 =5vt3t

v = 1.2 m s−1

Magnitude of his average velocity

=(vt)2+(2v2t)2t+2t 1M

=17v2t23t

=17v23

=17×1.223

= 1.65 m s−1 1A

tb-201-12.question:

You are given a measuring tape, a digital stop-watch, a light-gate, a piece of card and some adhesive tape.

(a) Describe an experiment to measure the average speed of the toy car travelling from X to Y. (3 marks)

(b) Describe an experiment to measure the instantaneous speed of the toy car at Z. (5 marks)
tb-201-12.answer:
(a) Measure the distance D between X and Y using the measuring tape. 1A

Release the car from rest at X and measure the time taken T for it to reach Y using the stopwatch. 1A

The average speed is DT. 1A

(b) Fix a piece of card on the car. Measure the width d of the card using the measuring tape. (The width of the card should be only a few centimetres.) 1A

Place the light-gate at the position as shown.

The card must block the light beam of the light-gate when the car passes Z. 1A

(Correct position of light gate) 1A

Start data-logging and release the car. Record the time t that the light beam is block. 1A
